sourceBasis.step: Encode the k vertices of a clique choice in O(k log n) Boolean variables, using clauses to forbid invalid vertices, repetitions and nonedges. Liu and Meng’s reduction then supplies a monopolar graph and a vertex order of width p with p² = O(k log n), in fixed-parameter time. The intrinsic width is at most the width of the order. The computable cutoff for the exponent converts any algorithm with the displayed running time into a fixed-parameter algorithm for Clique.
